title: The Fallen Nest
text: A great nest has fallen from the canopy and burst open across the path, a tangle of branches and down and old bones. In the middle sits an egg the size of a shield, still warm. High above, something is screaming.

options.label: The strongest lifts the egg back to the canopy.

outcomes.text: A cry of thanks from above, and a feather as long as an arm drifts down.
The parent thinks you are stealing it, and comes down out of the sky.
A rare egg, warm against the back, and a shadow circling above you all the rest of the day.
It will be what it will be. The canopy, which was watching, lets you pass unharmed and the road is easy.
It will be what it will be. At dusk you hear the mother looking for it, and then you hear her find your trail.
